title: smtp: document that Newsgroups: header does not auto-route to NNTP
description: Incoming SMTP email with a Newsgroups: header is NOT automatically injected into NNTP. This is intentional: auto-routing on that header would allow any authenticated SMTP user to inject articles into arbitrary newsgroups without explicit operator policy. Operators who want email→newsgroup routing must write explicit Sieve rules using fileinto 'newsgroup:X'. This issue documents this decision and tracks adding a comment in the code and/or operator documentation.
